content:
Measurement in Class 4 is all about conversions — mm to km, mg to kg, mL to L — plus adding and comparing measures. This guide covers what the IMO Class 4 measurement chapter tests, the conversion facts, the slips, and a free 10-question test.

What the Class 4 Maths Olympiad Measurement chapter tests

  • Length (mm, cm, m, km) and conversions
  • Weight (mg, g, kg)
  • Capacity (mL, L)
  • Adding, subtracting and comparing measures in word problems

Key facts your child should know

  • 1 cm = 10 mm; 1 m = 100 cm; 1 km = 1000 m.
  • 1 g = 1000 mg; 1 kg = 1000 g; 1 L = 1000 mL.
  • Bigger → smaller unit: multiply. Smaller → bigger: divide.
  • Convert to the same unit before adding: 6 kg 750 g + 2 kg 850 g = 9 kg 600 g.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Multiplying instead of dividing (or vice-versa) in conversions.
  • Adding mixed units without converting first.
  • Dropping a zero in ×1000 conversions.

quiz.title: IMO Class 4 Measurement Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten Olympiad-pattern questions. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: How many metres are there in 9 km?
An electric wire of 14 m 10 cm is bought, and 6 m 45 cm of it is used for wiring a room. How much wire is left?
A canteen buys 3 cans of oil, each of 1 L 500 mL. It uses 2 L 800 mL for frying. How much oil remains?
questions.explanation: Bought = 1500 x 3 = 4500 mL. Remaining = 4500 - 2800 = 1700 mL = 1 L 700 mL.

questions.q: How many millilitres are there in 7 L?
A jogging loop in a park is 250 m around. How many rounds make 1 km 500 m?
A curtain piece measures 725 cm. Express this length in metres and centimetres.
questions.explanation: 100 cm = 1 m. 725 cm = 7 m and 25 cm, i.e. 7 m 25 cm.

questions.q: Each bag of rice weighs 2 kg 500 g. What is the total weight of 3 such bags?
questions.explanation: 2 kg 500 g = 2500 in the smallest unit. 2500 × 3 = 7500, which is 7 kg 500 g.

questions.q: An underground water pipeline is 9905 m. Express this distance in kilometres and metres.
A courier van covers 1 km 300 m to the depot, 2 km 750 m to the market and 4 km 200 m to the mall. What is the total distance covered?

faq.q: How many grams are in 2.5 kg?
faq.a: 2500 g — multiply by 1000 when converting kilograms to grams.

faq.q: How do you add 1 m 40 cm and 2 m 75 cm?
faq.a: Convert to cm (140 + 275 = 415 cm) then back: 4 m 15 cm.
